# Rimski Logtens

> Rimski Logtens, based in Cuijk (Netherlands), is a BSc Artificial Intelligence student at Radboud University (Nijmegen, Netherlands, 2024–2027) and a Student Product Specialist at Mantel, working on SEO, GEO, CRO, CRM and pricing strategy.

## Current roles
- Student Product Specialist, Mantel (Sep 2025–Sep 2026, part-time, hybrid, Arnhem-Nijmegen region): content management, pricing strategy execution, SEO and GEO improvement, CRM improvement, KPI tracking.
- Sport Commissaris, 35th board of N.S.W.V. Mercurius (Sep 2026–present): day-to-day operations, committee work, training coordination.

## Previous experience
- Allround Employee, Primetime (Jun 2024–Jan 2025): logistics, inventory control, order processing.
- Student Actor, Kandinsky College (Aug 2021–Jul 2024): coached teachers in class management through simulated scenarios and constructive feedback.

## Skills

- Languages: English (C2), Dutch (C2), German (B2), French (A2)
